liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Phil And Ned** (2 reviews): Extended, dreamy piece that flows straight into Wharf Rat; Roughly forty minutes of free-form noise that turns a good show into a tedious long jam [12][15]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Jerry's jam is mellow and intertwined, among the best versions this listener has heard [14]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Very long, jazzy version that points toward the band's direction and the later jazz-fusion leanings of the Blues For Allah period [12]
- **Seastones (Phil & Ned)** (1 other source): Ned Lagin plays electric piano and synthesizer; this segment comes from an alternate audience source [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Phil And Ned**: rare: 14 archived performances [24]
- **Happy Birthday Bobby**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-10-16.sbd.patched.eaton-miller.90145.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 249 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd74-10-16.sbd-patched.unknown.222.fails-md5.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 26 songs; 251 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this about as good as this soundboard gets; Known flaws include a reel flip on disc three and cuts in Eyes Of The World and Uncle John's Band [2][15]
- **gd1974-10-16.sbd.miller.88180.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 250 min [4]
- **gd1974-10-16.176619.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 25 songs; 235 min [5]
- **gd1974-10-16.fob.sonyecm250.falenga.motb-0131.107036.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 234 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer's own sing-along is audible on the first three or four songs of this audience tape; Audience tape is tolerable by the standards of the era and well taped, though the soundboard is still preferred [18][21]
- **gd74-10-16.sbd.fishman.12577.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 232 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [9]. Said about its sound: Moderate hiss runs throughout this soundboard copy; The download has songs out of sequence and a gap in the middle of Playin' [13]

## Around the show

- Phil sang Bobby a cracked Happy Birthday amid onstage banter; the night opened a legendary run [12]
- Only about two songs from the show were officially released, as bonus features rather than in the Dead movie [17]
- Reviewer attended four of the five nights; all were packed, as this was the band's final run of shows [21]
- Reviewer says 1974 is full of shows like this one [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-10-16.sbd.patched.eaton-miller.90145.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]. Also: Bertha through 1:16 of Deal is patched from an audience source; Playing In The Band from 18:03 through 7:35 of the Jam is patched from master reel to cassette to DAT; Matt Smith's first-generation audience reel fills short gaps in Eyes Of The World and Uncle John's Band [1]
- **gd74-10-16.sbd-patched.unknown.222.fails-md5.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Soundboard from master reel through cassette and DAT to CD, with audience patches, passed via A. Kowalski to BUDD and GDH-Trading [2]
- **gd1974-10-16.sbd.miller.88180.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) D [4]. Also: Bertha through 1:16 of Deal is patched from an audience source; The reel flip in Playing In The Band is patched from the multitrack reel [4]
- **gd1974-10-16.176619.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Louis Falanga's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM 250 mic > Sony TC-110 (Maxell UD C120) [5]
- **gd1974-10-16.fob.sonyecm250.falenga.motb-0131.107036.flac16**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke and David Minches and Derek McCabe; source: Sony ECM 250 >> Sony 110 (mono) >> MAC [7]
- **gd74-10-16.sbd.fishman.12577.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]. Also: This later Archive upload is considered a downgrade by consensus; the other 10-16 version is preferred [16]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by KAMPGROUND DESIGNS: [Grateful Dead's Cumberland Blues - Winterland 10/16/74 — KAMPGROUND DESIGNS](https://www.kampgrounddesigns.com/store/p/mirrorball-cards-cumberland-blues) [29]
